own_symbolic_findings: Normalized causal predictive conditionals define a sequential joint law without requiring iid/exchangeability; not automatically the exact TabICL pretraining-prior marginal or posterior probability of shared true functions.
Product of blockwise predictive marginals and a shared-latent-function joint predictive law differ in general.
Lag covariates may reveal previous targets; conditioning must use information available at each prediction time.
For z=(y-a)/s the original-unit log density has the -log(s) Jacobian; identical scales can cancel and already-inverted quantiles must not be corrected twice.

Different symmetric noises with the same conditional median require no separate oracle MAE predictors, but their separate oracle log scores improve over the pooled mixture by a positive Jensen-Shannon divergence. Population counterexample, not a finite-data BHC or network performance result.

The implementation clamps dQ/dalpha to [1e-6,1e6]; a finite returned pdf thereby has a positive floor. Literal extension across the full real support is not an exact normalized continuous density. Numerical impact on actual data was not measured.
Block-factorized prefix score work is R(N+P) context preparations and RQ(N+2P) query rows before additional search/merge costs. Union-symmetrized top-k graph has P<=Nk, not generally Nk/2.
decision: Do not adopt or run this candidate: available evidence does not resolve novelty, point-forecast objective mismatch or RCTL sharing benefit. Not a claim that Bayesian clustering is universally invalid.
